augmentationPolicy.originalPrefix: Copy all original v2 row bytes as the exact v3 prefix, preserving their order and supervision unchanged.
augmentationPolicy.variantOrder: Append one variant per parent in original parent order.
augmentationPolicy.exampleId: Parent exampleId followed by -citation-view01; experimental sample identity only.
augmentationPolicy.keyDerivation: For each old fragment key: view01:k- followed by the first 16 lowercase hex digits of SHA256(UTF8(parent exampleId + U+0000 + old key)). Require a collision-free bijection per row.
augmentationPolicy.evidenceOrder: Reverse the original evidence array; a single-fragment row is still re-keyed.
augmentationPolicy.outputKeys: Replace citation keys consistently in every claim, conflict and abstention. Preserve array order and every other output field, including exact quotes, roles, states, literals, units and empty canonicalLinks.
augmentationPolicy.sourceInvariance: Preserve every fragment's familyId, sourceSha256, method, locator and text exactly. Do not normalize spelling, OCR, identifiers, whitespace, dates or source text.
augmentationPolicy.supervision: Preserve original supervision except augmentation=true on variants and one explicit citationViewAugmentation object recording this version, parent data/row hashes and ID, key bijection, old/new evidence order and assignment provenance. Keep originals and variants provisional; no new fact or independent truth.
